backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor; static asset canisters handle deployment with no backend logic required.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three implemented features: Get Started button functionality with toast notification, gold button styling (#D4AF37), and smooth hover/click animations.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON summary of all frontend files including styling, components, legal views, deployment docs, and the landing page with fully functional Get Started buttons.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment guide for Internet Computer (ICP) hosting with sections on free hosting, global CDN, and public URLs for mobile app integration (content truncated).
frontend/deployment/latest-public-urls.m: Handoff artifact documenting primary production URL (https://smartsalonapp.com) for mobile app integration with quick reference snippets (content truncated).
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS with dark luxury OKLCH theme tokens for background, foreground, card, primary, secondary, muted, accent, destructive, border, and chart colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with Smart Salon branding, SEO meta tags, canonical URL (https://smartsalonapp.com/), Open Graph tags, and favicon references.
frontend/public/.well-known/ic-domains: ICP custom domain allowlist containing smartsalonapp.com and www.smartsalonapp.com for canister domain verification.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component with QueryClient, ThemeProvider (dark mode default), LandingPage render, and Toaster for global notifications.
frontend/src/components/legal/ContactVie: Contact view component displaying email and phone links with icons in premium card layout using shared CONTACT_INFO constants.
frontend/src/components/legal/LegalModal: Reusable modal component with scrollable content area, header, close button, and dark premium styling for displaying legal documents.
frontend/src/components/legal/PrivacyPol: Privacy Policy view with sections on information collection, usage, sharing, retention, security, user rights, and contact details (content truncated).
Terms & Conditions view covering acceptance, service use, bookings/cancellations, payments, salon responsibilities, disclaimers, liability, and termination (content truncated).
frontend/src/content/legal.ts: Shared constants for contact information (email, phone) and company details (name, last updated date) used across legal components.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that manages the backend actor instance using React Query, creating authenticated or anonymous actors based on Internet Identity state and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context and hooks for ICP integration, managing login/logout state, identity persistence, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom dark luxury theme using CSS variables (dark blue-black background, gold accents #D4AF37), typography settings, and utility classes for the Smart Salon app.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and wraps the App component with InternetIdentityProvider and QueryClientProvider.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Landing page component featuring hero section, feature cards (booking, dashboard, settings, service discovery), mobile app preview, About section, footer with social links, and legal modals (contact, privacy, terms) with a dark luxury theme and gold accents.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending the default theme with custom OKLCH color system for dark luxury design, custom spacing, shadows, animations, and typography using Inter font family.
project_state.json: Project state document tracking the evolution of the Smart Salon landing page design requirements, including layout rules (80% width, 2.5 gutters), dark theme with gold accents, removal of gamification elements, and addition of About/legal sections for domain smartsalonapp.com.
